description: This file defines the PatientProgram class, representing a patient's enrollment in a healthcare program within the OpenMRS system. It includes properties for patient details, program status, enrollment and completion dates, states, attributes, and methods for managing states and transitions.

classes.name: PatientProgram
classes.description: Represents a patient's enrollment in a healthcare program, manages states, attributes, and transitions related to the patient's program status.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of this PatientProgram, deep copying the 'states' property.

methods.name: copyHelper
methods.description: Helper method to copy properties into a target PatientProgram instance, enabling subclass extensions.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Returns whether the patient is currently enrolled in the program on the given date.

methods.name: getPatientState
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientState by its ID from the patient's program states.

methods.name: transitionToState
methods.description: Transitions the patient's program to a new state, performing validation for valid transitions.

methods.name: voidLastState
methods.description: Voids the latest PatientState in the program for a particular workflow.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Retrieves the current PatientState for a given ProgramWorkflow.

methods.name: getCurrentStates
methods.description: Returns all current active PatientStates.

methods.name: getMostRecentStateInEachWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the most recent state in each workflow.

methods.name: statesInWorkflow
methods.description: Returns a list of PatientStates within a specific workflow.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object.toString() to provide a string representation of the PatientProgram.

methods.name: getOutcome
methods.description: Gets the outcome concept associated with the program.

methods.name: setOutcome
methods.description: Sets the outcome concept for the program.

methods.name: getDateCompleted
methods.description: Returns the date when the program was completed.

methods.name: setDateCompleted
methods.description: Sets the date when the program was completed.

methods.name: getDateEnrolled
methods.description: Returns the date when the patient enrolled in the program.

methods.name: setDateEnrolled
methods.description: Sets the enrollment date for the program.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Returns the patient associated with this program.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Associates a patient with this program.

methods.name: getPatientProgramId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this PatientProgram.

methods.name: setPatientProgramId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this PatientProgram.

methods.name: getProgram
methods.description: Returns the program associated with this patient.

methods.name: setProgram
methods.description: Sets the program for this PatientProgram.

methods.name: getStates
methods.description: Returns the set of PatientStates associated with this program.

methods.name: setStates
methods.description: Sets the collection of PatientStates.
